what_it_does: Team chat with channels, DMs, apps and workflow automation.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 (v2) issues user tokens and bot tokens; app-level tokens also exist; request signing verifies inbound Slack requests. Official MCP uses confidential OAuth with user-token scopes.
access_notes: Anyone can create an app; Slack Developer Program gives free Enterprise-style developer sandboxes with no payment method for a basic sandbox. Since 2025-05-29, commercially distributed non-Marketplace apps get conversations.history/replies cut to Tier 1 (1 req/min, 15 objects); internal and Marketplace apps keep normal limits.
api_notes: Web API with hundreds of methods (chat, conversations, users, files, reactions, etc.) plus Events API, Socket Mode and webhooks.
main_blocker: Marketplace approval needed for full rate limits on distributed apps
human_needed: submit app to Slack Marketplace review for production-grade history/replies limits

what_it_does: Programmable SMS, voice, WhatsApp, email and verification APIs.
auth_notes: HTTP Basic auth: API key SID + secret (recommended) or Account SID + Auth Token where the reference requires it.
access_notes: Free trial without credit card; per-product free units (e.g. 100 SMS, 75 voice minutes); 30-day expiry; only up to 5 verified recipients, sign-up country only, template-only message bodies.
api_notes: Large REST surface (Twilio cites 1,800+ APIs) across Messaging, Voice, Verify, Lookup, Conversations, SendGrid, etc.; public OpenAPI specs.

what_it_does: Zoho's team chat with channels, bots, meetings and automation.
auth_notes: Zoho OAuth 2.0: register client at api-console.zoho.com, authorization code flow, 'Zoho-oauthtoken' header, 1-hour access tokens with refresh; multi-data-center accounts.zoho.{dc} domains; scopes like ZohoCliq.Channels.READ.
access_notes: Free plan exists and lists developer-platform quotas (bots, functions, internal apps); OAuth client registration is self-serve. Explicit statement that REST API is on Free not found.
api_notes: REST API v3 (current; v2 still supported): chats, messages, threads, channels, reminders, attachments, bots, slash commands, functions, datastores, etc.

what_it_does: ByteDance collaboration suite: chat, docs, calendar, base and approvals.
auth_notes: Custom apps exchange app_id + app_secret for tenant_access_token (2h) via /open-apis/auth/v3/tenant_access_token/internal; user_access_token via OAuth 2.0 user consent; app_access_token for store apps.
access_notes: Apps created self-serve in Developer Console (open.larksuite.com/app). Some scopes are no-review; others need a version submitted and tenant-admin approval; test enterprises allow scopes without review. Multi-tenant store apps need Lark platform listing review (ISV qualification). Free Lark plan availability not directly verified (search budget exhausted).
api_notes: Open Platform server APIs across IM, docs/drive, calendar, base, approval, contacts, etc.
main_blocker: store-app listing review / tenant admin approval for scopes
human_needed: tenant admin approves scopes; ISV qualification for marketplace distribution

what_it_does: Team chat by CAKE.com with channels, DMs and calls.
auth_notes: API-keys addon generates per-user API keys (Swagger 'Authorize'); custom apps in Workspace settings yield App key + user/bot tokens (sent as 'token' and 'x-app-token' headers to the MCP). OAuth for third-party apps not confirmed.
access_notes: API keys addon 'available on all plans' for owners, admins and members; MCP 'available to all Pumble users'. Existence of free plan not directly fetched.
api_notes: API-keys addon covers send/reply/delete messages, reactions, create channels, list channels/messages; 1,000 req/min per user. Docs at pumble-api-keys.addons.marketplace.cake.com/api-docs/.

what_it_does: Community chat platform with servers, channels, voice and bots.
auth_notes: Bot token from an application created in the Developer Portal; OAuth2 for user authorization/bot install. Privileged intents (Server Members, Message Content) must be toggled in the portal. Official auth docs could not be fetched (allowlist).
access_notes: Applications/bots created free at discord.com/developers/applications. Verification requirements for large bots not verified.
api_notes: REST API plus WebSocket Gateway for events; guilds, channels, messages, members, roles, webhooks, etc. (from general knowledge; official reference not fetched).

what_it_does: Cloud messaging app with an HTTP Bot API for bots and channels.
auth_notes: Bot token issued by @BotFather (/newbot), embedded in Bot API URL. MTProto user-client API (api_id/api_hash) also exists but not verified here.
access_notes: Any Telegram user can create a bot via BotFather for free. Official core.telegram.org page was not fetchable (allowlist), evidence via community README linking it.
api_notes: HTTP Bot API (https://core.telegram.org/bots/api) with many methods: messages, media, chats, inline, payments, webhooks/getUpdates.

what_it_does: Meta's Cloud API for business messaging on WhatsApp.
auth_notes: Graph API access token (temporary, or permanent System User token) with whatsapp_business_messaging/whatsapp_business_management permissions plus Phone Number ID / WABA ID; Facebook Login for Business (OAuth) for tech-provider onboarding.
access_notes: Meta developer app with WhatsApp product gives test credentials (per community docs). Production requires Meta business portfolio; business verification/app review for multi-tenant scopes not confirmed from official page (get-started page not fetchable). Official MCP is explicitly for dev/testing, not production sending at scale.
api_notes: Cloud API (messages, media, templates, phone numbers) and Business Management API on Graph API.
main_blocker: Meta business verification / app review for production
human_needed: complete Meta business verification and app review for advanced permissions

what_it_does: Cloud phone system for sales and support teams.
auth_notes: Customers: Basic auth with api_id:api_token generated in Dashboard > Integrations > API keys. Technology Partners: OAuth 2.0 (admin consent, non-expiring Bearer token).
access_notes: Requires an Aircall account to generate API keys; OAuth client credentials only after Tech Partner program approval (developer account initially a 4-month trial). Customer free trial availability not verified.
api_notes: Users, teams, calls, contacts, numbers, tags, webhooks, messages/WhatsApp, conversation intelligence, analytics; 120 req/min per company.
human_needed: apply to Aircall Tech Partner program; obtain Aircall account

what_it_does: Communications APIs for SMS, voice, video, messaging and verification.
auth_notes: API key + secret (Basic auth / params) for many APIs; JWT signed with Application ID private key required for Voice/Messages and webhooks; signed messages supported.
access_notes: Sign-up gives API key/secret and free credit; pay-per-request top-ups afterwards.
api_notes: Messages, SMS, Voice, Verify, Video, Number Insight, Account, Numbers etc.; OpenAPI specs at developer.vonage.com/api.
